ayahs.ar: حمٓ
ayahs.tl: Haa Meeem
ayahs.en: Ha, Meem.

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.tl: Wal Kitaabil Mubeen
ayahs.en: By the clear Book,

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.tl: Innaaa anzalnaahu fee lailatim mubaarakah; innaa kunnaa munzireen
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

ayahs.ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.tl: Feehaa yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem
ayahs.en: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -

ayahs.ar: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
ayahs.tl: Amram min 'indinaaa; innaa kunnaa mursileen
ayahs.en: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

ayahs.ar: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.tl: Rahmatam mir rabbik; innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.tl: Rabbis samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa; in kuntum mooqineen
ayahs.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

ayahs.ar: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.tl: Laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen
ayahs.en: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

ayahs.ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.tl: Bal hum fee shakkiny yal'aboon
ayahs.en: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

ayahs.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.tl: Fartaqib Yawma taatis samaaa'u bidukhaanim mubeen
ayahs.en: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.

ayahs.ar: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.tl: Yaghshan naasa haazaa 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

ayahs.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.tl: Rabbanak shif 'annal 'azaaba innaa mu'minoon
ayahs.en: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

ayahs.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.tl: Annaa lahumuz zikraa wa qad jaaa'ahum Rasoolum mubeen
ayahs.en: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
ayahs.tl: Summaa tawallaw 'anhu wa qaaloo mu'allamum majnoon
ayahs.en: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.tl: Innaa kaashiful 'azaabi qaleelaa; innakum 'aaa'indoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.tl: Yawma nabtishul batsha tal kubraa innaa muntaqimoon
ayahs.en: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad fatannaa qablahum qawma Fir'awna wa jaaa'ahum Rasoolun kareem
ayahs.en: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

ayahs.ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.tl: An addooo ilaiya 'ibaadal laahi innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
ayahs.en: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

ayahs.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.tl: Wa al laa ta'loo 'alal laahi innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen
ayahs.en: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
ayahs.tl: Wa innee 'uztu bi Rabbee wa rabbikum an tarjumoon
ayahs.en: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

ayahs.ar: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.tl: Wa il lam tu'minoo lee fa'taziloon
ayahs.en: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

ayahs.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.tl: Fada'aa rabbahooo anna haaa'ulaaa'i qawmum mujrimoon
ayahs.en: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

ayahs.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.tl: Fa asri bi'ibaadee lailan innakum muttaba'oon
ayahs.en: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

ayahs.ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
ayahs.tl: Watrukil bahra rahwan innahum jundum mughraqoon
ayahs.en: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

ayahs.ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.tl: Kam tarakoo min jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
ayahs.en: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

ayahs.ar: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.tl: Wa zuroo'inw wa maqaa min kareem
ayahs.en: And crops and noble sites

ayahs.ar: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.tl: Wa na'matin kaanoo feehaa faakiheen
ayahs.en: And comfort wherein they were amused.

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa qawman aakhareen
ayahs.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.tl: Famaa bakat 'alaihimus samaaa'u wal ardu wa maa kaanoo munzareen
ayahs.en: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad najjainaa Baneee Israaa'eela minal'azaabil muheen
ayahs.en: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

ayahs.ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.tl: Min Fir'awn; innahoo kaana 'aaliyam minal musrifeen
ayahs.en: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqadikh tarnaahum 'alaa 'ilmin 'alal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa aatainaahum minal aayaati maa feehi balaaa'um mubeen
ayahs.en: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.tl: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i la yaqooloon
ayahs.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.tl: In hiya illaa mawtatunal oolaa wa maa nahnu bimun shareen
ayahs.en: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

ayahs.ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.tl: Faatoo bi aabaaa'inaaa inkuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.tl: Ahum khayrun am qawmu Tubba'inw wallazeena min qablihim; ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen
ayahs.en: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa baina humaa laa'ibeen
ayahs.en: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

ayahs.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.tl: Maa khalaqnaahumaaa illaa bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.tl: Inna yawmal fasli meeqaatuhum ajma'een
ayahs.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.tl: Yawma laa yughnee mawlan 'am mawlan shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon
ayahs.en: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.tl: Illaa mar rahimal laah' innahoo huwal 'azeezur raheem
ayahs.en: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.tl: Inna shajarataz zaqqoom
ayahs.en: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum

ayahs.ar: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
ayahs.tl: Ta'aamul aseem
ayahs.en: Is food for the sinful.

ayahs.ar: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
ayahs.tl: Kalmuhli yaghlee filbutoon
ayahs.en: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

ayahs.ar: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.tl: Kaghalyil hameem
ayahs.en: Like the boiling of scalding water.

ayahs.ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.tl: Khuzoohu fa'tiloohu ilaa sawaaa'il Jaheem
ayahs.en: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.tl: Summa subboo fawqa raasihee min 'azaabil hameem
ayahs.en: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

ayahs.ar: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
ayahs.tl: Zuq innaka antal 'azeezul kareem
ayahs.en: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.tl: Inna haazaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.tl: Innal muttaqeena fee maqaamin ameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;

ayahs.ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.tl: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
ayahs.en: Within gardens and springs,

ayahs.ar: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.tl: Yalbasoona min sundusinw wa istbraqim mutaqaabileen
ayahs.en: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika wa zawwajnaahum bihoorin 'een
ayahs.en: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

ayahs.ar: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.tl: Yad'oona feehaa bikulli faakihatin aamineen
ayahs.en: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.tl: Laa yazooqoona feehal mawtaa illal mawtatal oolaa wa qaqaahum 'azaabal jaheem
ayahs.en: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

ayahs.ar: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.tl: Fadlam mir rabbik; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem
ayahs.en: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.tl: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika la'allahum yatazakkaroon
ayahs.en: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.

ayahs.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.tl: Fartaqib innahum murta qiboon
ayahs.en: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
